name: Oily-water separators (API/CPI)
description: Gravity oil-water separators at the head of an industrial effluent train: long baffled API-type basins designed to API 421, or corrugated/tilted plate pack (CPI/PPI) coalescers that reach smaller droplets in a smaller footprint. Skimmed oil is recovered; the oily water flows on to flotation and biological treatment.

specifications.basis: API 421 traditional separators remove droplets down to about 150 micron under ideal conditions
effluent of 100 mg/L or less of non-emulsified free oil droplets 150 micron and larger
plate separators down to about 60 micron, 40 micron in enhanced designs
45-minute design residence; velocity capped at 0.015 m/s; length-to-width ratio at least 5:1
